text.en:
The Governor Villavert Jimenez National High School in the Municipality of Hamtic, Province
of Antique, is hereby transferred to Barangay Abaca, Municipality of Tobias Fornier, also in the Province of

The transfer of said school to its new site shall be under the supervision of the Ministry of
Education, Culture and Sports.

The Moscoso-Rios High School shall continue to operate at Funda, Hamtic, Antique as an
extension of the General Leandro Fullon National School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: Decmebr 3, 1985
